cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Secure the Endorsement
cards.instruction: Get a visible endorsement that makes your decision or position harder to challenge.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. Would you endorse the new rota into this microphone?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I already said it was fine.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. Quietly. Quietly can't protect me at the staff meeting.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Copy everyone who might blame me.

mechanism: A uses its pupil public-speaking lesson to obtain a visible rota endorsement it can use against criticism.
confusable: Not merely seeking praise or credit: endorsement must reach potential challengers.
comparison: Spoken endorsement turns into copied email; signature case turns concealment into identifiable support.
seedUse: D52 rota/microphone/email; S05 correct reach and volume as learned endorsement skills.
